fusions.name: Forked Taste
fusions.desc: Flicks a forked lash of venom that deals 4 damage, then leaps to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of that. Each hit has a 25% chance of [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Venom Down Both Roads
fusions.desc: Sprays venom in a cone 4 tiles long that deals 12 damage to everything in it, with a 60% chance of [Poisoned] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each target then spread to every enemy within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Taste and Return
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, each affliction laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it.

fusions.name: The Other Branch
fusions.desc: Once every 12 seconds, a dodge roll that failed is rolled again, and the second roll stands.
